'''[[Garindan (V)]]''' was published in [[Virtual Block 7]]. Its release-sheet and master-list versions are shown below.

== Release-sheet version ==
[[File:VL-history-1273-4-front-original.png|180px|Release-sheet version front face]]

=== Garindan (V) (front) ===
{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Printed value
|-
| Title || Garindan (V)
|-
| Uniqueness || 1
|-
| Power || 1
|-
| Ability || 2
|-
| Deploy || 3
|-
| Forfeit || 3
|}

{{anchor|original-front-text}}
[Pilot] 1. May deploy -1 as a ‘react’; shuffle any Reserve Deck. Ignores Objective deployment restrictions. Unless alone, may place Garindan in Used Pile to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny here. [Virtual Block 2] Imperial Domination ignores Garindan.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Players Committee virtual-card sheet], PDF page 2. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
